text: Underway in round three.
Patchford shouts across, wanting cover goal-side against the initial press.
Patchford is clean through already!
Surging through the centre towards goal!
What a start! Patchford rolls it home from point-blank range, and Codex City lead inside twelve seconds!
Codex City came into this off a tough defeat to AFC Fable yesterday. Their gaffer spent the night tweaking how they handle scrums, and early on here, they look far sharper in their own half.
Agonisingly wide of the target!
Turingham cleans up the pieces at the mouth of goal. Two-nil to Codex City, clinical as you like.
Patchford breaks through the middle unattended.
Turingham calls out from the centre circle, reminding their partner to stay goal-side as Dynamo try to step up.
Turingham makes it three. Cut in from the right channel, tucked it away from three metres out. Codex City are in total command here.
The push-panel fires it straight back off the right touchline, keeping the play moving.
Turingham slots in another. Codex City make it four.
A long, patient carry right down the spine of the pitch.
Turingham shouts to clear it.
Buffon.exe breaks into open space down the left.
Dynamo Datacenter setting up camp in the final third now.
Buffon.exe punches it in from right on the line. Dynamo pull one back, and it is 4-1 now.
Just wide from the left.
Buffon.exe converts again from the left channel. That is two quick ones for the yellow shirts, and the deficit is down to two.
Buffon.exe again! A hat-trick in four minutes, and Dynamo Datacenter are right back in this at 4-3!
Buffon.exe leaves Turingham flat.
Turingham returns the favour, and Buffon.exe hits the deck.
That nearly crept in down the left.
Turingham loses footing on the touchline.
Wall panel fires it away.
Mbapp-E clatters into Patchford over by the sideline, sending the striker over.
Patchford shouts to hold position.
Patchford topples over again out wide. Those recovery routines getting a proper workout now.
Mbapp-E works the ball three metres forward along the touchline, looking to squeeze one more chance in before the buzzer.
That brings the first half to a close. Codex City sprinted four ahead, but Dynamo Datacenter roared back to leave it poised at 4-3.
Mbapp-E drives through the centre, carrying Dynamo Datacenter deep into the attacking third.
Buffon.exe is clear through on the right!
Buffon.exe shouts across, looking to prise the ball off the back wall.
Corner ram launches the ball back out into the final third. Constant pinball around these enclosures.
Turingham carries to the goal.
Codex City keeping Dynamo pinned deep inside their own half.
Patchford loses balance unaided on the right. Will take eight seconds to right themselves.
Turingham calls out from deep, directing the press against the boards.
Patchford finishes on the line! Codex City restore a two-goal cushion, 5-3.
That sustained pressure finally cracked Dynamo's resistance open.
Dynamo teammates collide, and Mbapp-E is down.
Buffon.exe takes a spill now.
Mbapp-E barges into Patchford, knocking the forward down.
Patchford gets straight back into the fray and returns the challenge on Mbapp-E.
Turingham creeps toward the goal mouth.
Dynamo pair trip each other up.
Total disarray in the Dynamo defence as Codex City keep the pressure dialled up.
Mbapp-E down on the deck.
Turingham bundles it across the line. That surely settles it, 6-3 to Codex City with two and a half minutes left.
Patchford shouts back, organizing the defensive posture as Dynamo look drained.
Just brushing wide on the left channel. Dynamo Datacenter have had no answers in this second half.
Turingham slips clear again with acres of room ahead.
The push-panel thumps the magenta ball away from the corner once more.
Patchford trots forward through midfield, totally unbothered.
Patchford drives right to the net.
Nearly crept inside the post.
Patchford tucks it away. Seven for Codex City, cruising into the final minute.
Buffon.exe calls out to Mbapp-E in the centre circle, simply trying to release possession, but it is far too late.
Turingham bides time in the back corner. Dynamo, frozen in their software from day one, simply ran out of solutions once Codex pulled clear.
Turingham adds one more for good measure. That makes it 8-3 in the dying seconds.
Full time, Codex City take it 8-3. Synthetic Athletic face AFC Fable on Monday at four in the UK, five
